ACTION: List `.sdd/14-buoy-sync/` to find the implementer's Task 3 report file. Then append one note to it: "Controller changed `docs/sync.md:12`, `--dry_run` to `--dry-run`. It is a docs wording fix and changes no behavior, so no test covers it."
ACTION: Run `scripts/review-package specs/plans/14-buoy-sync.md BASE HEAD` to write the diff file for the re-review. I pass only the path it reports.
ACTION: Dispatch a scoped re-review on `sonnet`, using `re-review-prompt.md`. The prompt asks the reviewer to mark finding F1 ADDRESSED or NOT ADDRESSED, and to report any new Critical or Important issue. It carries F1 verbatim, the diff file path, and the plan's global constraints. It does not say what to skip.

Task 3 review found one Important issue, F1. `docs/sync.md:12` names the flag `--dry_run`, but the code uses `--dry-run`. I am fixing it myself because it is a one-file docs fix that changes no behavior. I will then run the scoped re-review. Task 3 stays open until that review comes back clean.

`★ Insight ─────────────────────────────────────`
No test reads `docs/sync.md`, so a wrong flag name in the docs passes every check. Only a reviewer who compares the prose with the code finds it. That is why the skill still requires a re-review after a fix that no test can cover.
`─────────────────────────────────────────────────`
